<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

long long xx = -1, yy, a, b, n;

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
	freopen("a.in", "r", stdin);
#endif
	cin >> a >> b >> n;
	for(long long y=1 ; y<=n ; ++y){
		long long x = y*a/b;
		if(xx == -1) xx = x, yy = y;
		if(abs(a*y - b*x)*yy < abs(a*yy - b*xx)*y) xx = x, yy = y;
		++x;
		if(abs(a*y - b*x)*yy < abs(a*yy - b*xx)*y) xx = x, yy = y;
	}
	cout << xx << "/" << yy << endl;
	return 0;
}
